test_LoadImageFromFile_transform: test the LoadImageFromFile transform to load color images from disk files
test_LoadImageFromFile_float32: test the LoadImageFromFile transform with to_float32 to load images as float32 arrays
test_LoadImageFromFile_gray: test the LoadImageFromFile transform with color_type unchanged to load grayscale images
test_LoadMultiChannelImageFromFiles_tran: test the LoadMultiChannelImageFromFiles transform to load multiple images as a multi-channel array
test_LoadImageFromWebcam_transform: test the LoadImageFromWebcam transform to load in-memory numpy arrays as webcam images
